UNBEATABLE embodies a spirit of creative rebellion that feels not just cathartic, but downright necessary given the current state of the world. Combining arcade-style rhythm game action with a deep and engrossing coming-of-age narrative, playing UNBEATABLE feels like living in a long-lost summer anime from your adolescence. 

In short: It rules. You already know iam8bit loves to party like it’s 1999, so it’s no surprise we’re proud to partner with the D-CELL GAMES team and publisher PLAYSTACK to bring UNBEATABLE into the physical world. 

This is UNBEATABLE - Breakout Edition (Nintendo Switch 2 Exclusive Edition). It’s the entire game experience, complete on cartridge and wrapped in cover art from D-CELL’s Andrew Tsai. And when we say “entire game experience,” we mean it; this is the Breakout Edition so it’s got four all-new exclusive songs, a bunch of extra back catalogue songs, and even more songs that we’re not authorized to tell you about. It’s pretty serious. Plus, you’ve got 20+ additional arcade mode titles and a shiny new exclusive menu palette. 

Plus, you get a 12”x12” double-sided foldout poster with even more original art straight from Andrew’s skillful quill. And of course, since it’s an iam8bit Exclusive Edition, we’ve also included an o-sleeve that, in our humble opinion, kicks total ass. Its eclectic collage design pays homage to the implacable tidal wave of creativity that makes UNBEATABLE such a unique experience. 

Music is illegal. Time to do some crimes. Check out the entire UNBEATABLE collection here.

*Compatible with NTSC Genesis retro consoles

The story of Sonic the Hedgehog is the story of the 1990s. Born of a brilliant union between cutting-edge console technology and of-the-era super radical attitude, Sonic’s iconic design and in-your-face personality quickly solidified him as a bonafide pop culture icon, a flagbearer of everything hip, cool, and of course, fast. 

His debut adventure, the eponymous Sonic the Hedgehog, was an unprecedented kind of mascot platformer. Sonic races his way through intricately designed multilayered levels, speeding from checkpoints to boss fights to secret levels and beyond amidst a wonderfully synthy symphony of groovy background music. 

Now, 35 years later, iam8bit & SEGA are teaming up to celebrate Sonic’s massive impact on gaming with a once-in-a-lifetime commemoration. This is the Sonic the Hedgehog 35th Anniversary Legacy Cartridge, a meticulously crafted fully playable release of the legend that started it all. It comes in a gorgeous translucent Blue Blur cartridge shell, packed in a foldout foil box adorned with embellishments. Plus, you’ll find a full-color premium instruction booklet inside, the same kind you’d crack open and pore over on the ride home from the store.

Plus: 1 in 8 cartridges have been infused with genuine, bonda-fide Chaos Emerald energy! That’s right; our celebration of Sonic’s past collides head-first with the future, and in the wake of all that lightning-fast energy we’ve found fragments of the Emeralds themselves. These special cartridges will feature a unique translucent exterior, housing a Chaos Emerald inner glow.   

Complete your collection with the Sonic the Hedgehog 2 Legacy Cartridge here.

More than just an impressive debut, Blue Prince is a full-on revelation. Developer Dogubomb married narrative-driven exploration with tabletop tile placing mechanics to tell the story of Mount Holly, an ever-shifting mansion assembled by an enigmatic, puzzle-loving eccentric. Within the mansion’s walls, mysteries abound, and every day the floor plan changes, so there are always more secrets to uncover.

This is the Blue Prince (iam8bit Nintendo Switch 2 Exclusive Edition), an elite package that, like the game itself, contains so much to discover. First off, you’ll get the game on cartridge, ready to play out-of-the-box. And speaking of the box, it comes in a snug-fitting, high quality o–sleeve you’ll only find on iam8bit.com.

We’ve also included an 18”x12” fold-out poster, depicting the legendary Mount Holly on one side, and a mysterious painting of a crow on the other. Plus, you’ll get a download code for the ambient and beautiful digital soundtrack, the perfect background music for puzzling, working, or what-have-you. Last, but not least: A grid paper notebook booklet, with pages perfect for jotting down notes and potential solutions. If you haven’t played the game yet, take our word for it: You’ll need them. 

Whether you’re revisiting the manor or uncovering its mysteries for the first time, you’re in for a true treat.

products.title: Moomintroll: Winter’s Warmth (iam8bit PlayStation 5 Collector’s Edition)
products.body_html:
For decades, Tove Jansson’s pastoral world of Moomin has enchanted a worldwide audience of all ages. With countless comics, books, animated specials, and more under his belt, Moomintroll has now turned to the world of video games — and at just the perfect time, given the breakthrough smash success of the “cozy” genre. 

Moomintroll: Winter’s Warmth is indeed a cozy adventure. Set in the frigid world of Moominland’s midwinter (and based loosely on the beloved book bearing that name), Winter’s Warmth sees players guiding Moomintroll through a beautiful landscape inspired by the Nordic countryside. 

At iam8bit, we never turn down the chance to celebrate a global icon like Moomintroll. That’s why we’re so pleased to team up with Hyper Games to bring you this finely crafted assortment of riches. This is the Moomintroll: Winter’s Warmth (iam8bit PlayStation 5 Collector's Edition)! Inside, you’ll find the game on disc, along with a trove of treasures. 

There’s a massive 172 page hardcover artbook, your behind-the-scenes look at the world of Winter’s Warmth and all the love and care that went into its creation. And if you’re paging through that book on the go, why not keep it in your brand-new, mega-fashionable, super-sturdy Moomin tote bag? Heck, while you’re at it: Decorate your tote with some snazzy 1.5” hard enamel pins. They come complete on high quality backer cards and feature Moomin designs from the game itself. If that’s not enough Moomin for you, you’re in luck. We’ve also included a super cute Moomintroll keychain, complete with scarf and celebratory smile. 

Plus, you’ll get everything inside the Retail Edition of Winter’s Warmth. That’s two kiss cut sticker sheets, found inside the game case, as well as a digital download code for the game’s chilled-out soundtrack.

Whether you’re returning to Moominvalley or visiting for the very first time, you’re going to find so much to love here. Don’t miss out!

products.title: Wanderstop (iam8bit PlayStation 5 Exclusive Edition)
products.body_html:
Burnout is a very real thing, friends, and sooner or later, it comes for us all. Whether you’re holding down a 9-to-5 or making a name for yourself as one of the greatest fighters in recorded history, life can sometimes feel relentless. It's in those moments that the best offense is a good defense, and learning to let go is the only true way to level up. 

Therein lies the thesis of Wanderstop, a meditation on burnout wrapped up in the guise of a fun, fantastical cozy tea shop manager. Developer Ivy Road, with help from publisher Annapurna Interactive, realized a world that reflects our own, populated by complex and caring characters each on their own personal journey regarding work, life, and the balance between. 

At iam8bit, we love Wanderstop’s resonant message. That’s why we’re so proud to present  —drumroll please — Wanderstop (iam8bit PlayStation 5 Exclusive Edition)! 

In addition to the game on disc, you’ll get an exclusive Wanderstop sticker pack featuring your favorite in-game fungi, perfect for adorning your tea mug. Plus, you’ll get a double-sided 12”x18’ foldout poster featuring Alta, Boro, and a veritable flock of chaotic lil’ pluffins. 

And since this is an iam8bit Exclusive Edition, you already know you’re getting an exclusive o-sleeve to decorate your game case and add wow to your shelf. 

Don’t miss out on one of the best cozy games of this generation. Shop the entire iam8bit Wanderstop collection here.

products.title: Scott Pilgrim EX (Nintendo Switch Exclusive Edition)
products.body_html:
Scott Pilgrim EX is an action-adventure game where players can fight as Scott Pilgrim, Ramona Flowers and more as they battle through the fractured time and space of Toronto.

products.title: Xcavator 2025 (NES Cartridge)
products.body_html:
Here at iam8bit, its our firm belief that the preservation of video game history is crucial to the medium’s future as a commercial product, an art form, and everything in between. That’s why we’re so excited to partner with the Video Game History Foundation to bring you something truly special; a never-before-seen, long-lost prototype game from legendary programmer Chris Oberth. 

This is Xcavator 2025 (NES Cartridge), a fully functional NES title built from Oberth’s original design of the same name. First developed at Incredible Technologies Inc., the company behind coin-op classics like Golden Tee Golf, Big Buck Hunter, and more, Xcavator was shopped around to multiple publishers across the country way back in 1991, but it never found a home, and was quietly archived and never looked at again.

Recently, the prototype's source code was discovered and rebuilt by the Video Game History Foundation from Oberth's development archives, which were donated by his family after his unfortunate passing. Incredible Technologies then graciously agreed to donate the rights to the game to the VGHF to use as a fundraiser for its charitable work.

The Video Game History Foundation then worked with Mega Cat Studios to finish the game, staying true to Oberth’s original vision and using the tools and environments that Oberth would have utilized himself to make the game whole.

iam8bit took it from there, creating a truly unique and authentically retro package for Xcavator 2025 that includes a 14-page manual loaded with more info on Oberth and Xcavator, written by the fine folks of the VGHF themselves. It’s exhibit-quality stuff, available for your very own collection.

Best of all, 100% of the profits from the Xcavator 2025 NES Cartridge will go to fund the Video Game History Foundation, a 501(c)3 non-profit organization dedicated to preserving, celebrating, and teaching the history of video games.

This is a one-of-a-kind product made to support an important cause. Don’t miss your chance to be a part of video game history.

products.title: LEGO® Party! (PlayStation 5)
products.body_html:
LEGO® Party! is a 4-player party game that’s built different!

Compete against your friends in wacky Challenge Zones and 60 hilarious minigames from across your favorite LEGO sets like LEGO Pirates, LEGO Space, LEGO NINJAGO® and more.

Join your friends online no matter their platform, or get together for a LEGO Party game night. With multiple game modes and tons of minifigures to unlock, you’ll have all the bricks to build the ultimate Party!

Challenge players near or far, customize your character and compete in a variety of awesome minigames to get as many Golden Bricks as you can, by any means necessary! But beware, watch out for monsters, traps and flying roast turkeys on your way to become the next star of LEGO Party!

Play your way: Bring your friends and enjoy the mayhem in couch multiplayer or with cross-platform online multiplayer for up to 4 players. Whether it's competing for the perfect score in Rocketball, practicing against that pesky kraken in Kraken Up or boogieing down in Dance Off, you can enjoy LEGO Party! together or solo!

 

Go for the gold: In LEGO Party! you have one goal: to become the player with the most Golden Bricks! Use power-ups to gain the advantage and set up traps to sabotage your opponents across a range of customizable LEGO themed Challenge Zones.

 

Everything is awesome: Put your speed, wits, and LEGO expertise to the test across a variety of crazy minigames. Race to make dinner for aliens, run through collapsing tombs and skid round the track in rally races and so much more across 60 different wildly fun minigames.

 

You do you: With over 1 billion minifigure combinations from iconic LEGO sets, you can go with a classic look or design your own unique and outlandish minifigure. Show off your creation at the next party!

The folks at Wētā Workshop (and their friends at publisher Private Division) recognized the warm appeal of a Hobbit’s life, and thus Tales of The Shire was born.

We at iam8bit love to daydream about living in a Hobbit home, with days spent tending the land and nights filled with the comforts of home-cooked meals and hot cups of tea. That’s why we teamed up with Wētā Workshop to bring you this one-of-a-kind creation.

Presenting the Tales of the Shire Exclusive Edition, a celebration of all things cosy. You’ll get the game on disc/cart, region-free as always, with an idyllic cover sheet that captures the spirit of community and friendship only found in Bywater.

That’s not all; to fully transport you* to the world of Middle-earth, we’ve included a beautiful 20”x16” fold-out map for the quaint village of Bywater.

It’s a perfect pastoral vacation, squeezed down into a game box and packaged with all the love and care only iam8bit can provide.

products.title: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Into the Pit (Xbox Exclusive Edition)
products.body_html:
We at iam8bit don’t need to tell you what you already know: The extended world of Five Nights at Freddy’s has taken on an animatronic-esque life of its own, expanding into realms spanning feature films, metafiction, and beyond. And why not? The series’ fandom is downright voracious, consuming every bit of tantalizing lore available, wherever it can be found. 

Five Nights at Freddy’s: Into the Pit represents a rich vein of that delicious mythology. Based on the novel of the same name, it leaps into the past —literally, by way of the titular ball pit  — to tell an original narrative with all the thrills and chills you might expect from the series. 

The team at Mega Cat Studios worked hard to ensure every element of Into the Pit worked harmoniously with that “throwback” theme. Packed with lovingly-crafted pixel art and old-school adventure game puzzles, Into the Pit is truly a modern classic, and a gem of a beloved genre of yesteryear. Consider this physical edition a humble polishing of that gem. 

This is the Five Nights at Freddy’s: Into the Pit Exclusive Edition. In addition to the game itself, on glorious physical media, you’ll get a 12"x18" Glow in the Dark Fold-Out Poster, not available anywhere else. Give your room that animatronic ambiance you’ve always wanted. Plus, you’ll get a set of 3 Sticker Sheets, perfect for decorating your water bottle, notebook, or anywhere else that needs a bit of spine-tingling style. 

Do you dare descend into the pit? We’re waiting for you…

products.title: Outer Wilds: Archaeologist’s Edition (PlayStation 5 Retail)
products.body_html:
Outer Wilds is nothing short of a transcendent experience. The story of a solar system trapped in an ever-repeating time loop, Mobius Digital’s debut title tasks players with piecing together a galaxy-spanning mystery, tracing the footprints of an ancient, forgotten precursor species as they race against a 22-minute timer. 

Outer Wilds exploded like a supernova onto the indie game scene in 2019, but the definitive version took a little more time to arrive here on our planet – titled Outer Wilds: Archaeologist’s Edition, this game-of-the-year style bundle is the complete OW experience packaged together, including the decidedly-darker DLC Echoes of the Eye. 

We at iam8bit like to think of ourselves as intrepid intergalactic explorers, so we were all-too-pleased at the prospect of teaming up with our friends at Mobius Digital & their publisher Annapurna Interactive to bring the Archaeologist’s Edition to life with an out-of-this-world Retail Edition. 

Outer Wilds: Archaeologist Edition features the entire Outer Wilds experience on a single disc. To help you chart your exploration through the galaxy, it also comes with an exclusive foldout Planetary Chart designed by Mobius Digital Concept Artist Ian Jacboson.

This is the corrected physical version of the game that includes the base game and the Echoes of the Eye DLC on disc.

products.title: SCHiM (PlayStation 5 iam8bit Exclusive Edition)
products.body_html:
Remember leaping from shadow to shadow on lazy childhood summer days, pretending that anything the light touches was lava? The little games we made up as kids to while away the hours were nothing short of miraculous…and for those still in touch with that sense of childhood whimsy, they make for pretty phenomenal video game inspiration, too. 

SCHiM is an inventive 3D platformer that explores that simple, compelling concept, taking it to unexpectedly imaginative ends. In it, you play as a schim in search of their lost counterpart, deftly weaving from dark patch to dark patch as you navigate a relaxing, lively 3D-rendered environment.

It’s all about seeing the world from a new perspective. Developers Ewoud van der Werf & Nils Slijkerman have filtered the mundane through the lens of the widely creative to create something wholly new, something that we at iam8bit admire & adore. 

That’s why we leapt at the chance to work with them, and publisher Extra Nice on this: The SCHiM iam8bit Exclusive Edition.

In addition to the complete game on glorious physical media, you’ll get a substantially-sized 11”x17” Street Scene Poster, complete with a scene ripped straight from the game. And you can decorate that scene to your heart’s content, thanks to the 4 Character Stickers & Shadow Sheets packed inside, too. Plus, we worked with artist Owen D. Pomery to immortalize the unique look and feel of SCHiM with all-new, exclusive cover art. It’s a picture-perfect package for celebrating this one-of-a-kind platformer.

products.title: Cocoon (iam8bit Collector’s Edition)
products.body_html:
Cocoon is nothing short of a masterclass of game design, a mind-bending adventure set across worlds within worlds that challenges the player to think both laterally and creatively. Designer Jeppe Carlsen (lead gameplay designer of LIMBO & INSIDE) stretches the core mechanic of leaping from world to world to its absolute limits, crafting puzzles with sublime solutions that deftly run the gamut from “Ah Ha!” to “No Way?” to “Of Course!”, all while conveying a beautiful silent narrative and evoking visions of a techno-organic future that would make H.R. Giger blush.  

It’s the kind of game that students of design will be studying for years to come. Its meticulous craft is something to be celebrated, and that’s just what we at iam8bit have teamed up with Geometric Interactive and Annapurna Interactive to do. 

This is the Cocoon Collector’s Edition. In addition to the game, complete on disc/cartridge, you’ll receive a 3” laser-etched crystal orb light, complete with its own activator pedestal. Custom-built to match the game’s titular orbs, it’s the perfect fandom-flaunting piece to display on your desk or bookshelf.

We’ve also included a 11”x17”double-sided poster with all new, original art from Cocoon Art Director/Lead Artist Erwin Kho, celebrating the unique look & feel of the game’s wordless world. Plus: 5 Orb art cards, one for each of Cocoon’s unforgettable realms. And of course, no iam8bit Collector’s Edition would be complete without exclusive bespoke cover art. That’s why we tapped Kho to craft a brand-new piece to adorn the game’s box, too. 

It’s time to leap into a whole new world.

products.title: The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe (iam8bit Collector's Edition)
products.body_html:
Stanley clicked the link. As a long time appreciator of fine, premium tangible goods, he was a frequent visitor of the iam8bit web store. He loved to soak in all of the clever details of their collector’s editions, vinyl, and more, and, level-headed as he was, he never Tweeted impatiently at them regarding preorder wait times. 

On that day, one particular item caught his eye: It was The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe Collector’s Edition. Stanley had an interest in innovative, cleverly-penned indie games, especially when they playfully merged meta-commentary and ludological twists to build out whip-smart satire on interactive entertainment. 

As a result, he was a big fan of developer Crows Crows Crows’ The Stanley Parable, and the Ultra Deluxe edition, with its additive content and unexpected updates, was in particular his favorite version of the game. And this Collector’s Edition seemed like a true celebration of The Stanley Parable’s massive impact on the art form. 

Within its premium, delectable box was a world of extra goodies: First off, the game cover itself featured original exclusive cover art by Fatih Oztürk. What’s more, there was a The Stanley Parable: Reassurance Bucket Manual hiding inside, providing Stanley Parable-style instructions on how the purchaser could build their very own commemorative The Stanley Parable Collectible Bucket, using only a common bucket and the (also included) Official Stanley Parable Ultra Deluxe Merchandise Sticker. How innovative!  

And – what was this? – why, a figure of Stanley himself! How deliciously meta of the Collector’s Edition creators to include a 5” PVC Stanley figurine (also called Figleys, Stanlurines, Mini-Stans, Stanley-Figs, Figlureanlurines, Figanleys, Stiggley-Wiggleys). He couldn’t wait to unpack it and put it on his desk, so he could smile benignly at it and think back on all the fond memories he had built over the years, sitting at his desk. 

But what would Stanley listen to, there at that self same desk? Perhaps a digital edition of The Stanley Parable soundtrack, using the code included with this Collector’s Edition! It really did have everything. 

Yes, indeed: It was an honor for Stanley to be a small part of this monumental partnership between iam8bit and developer Crows Crows Crows, playing the role that he knew the very best: The Consumer. 


20% of net proceeds from your Stanley Parable purchase will be donated to the non-profit charity 350.org to fight climate change. Browse the collection here.

products.title: Sea of Stars (Xbox Exclusive Edition)
products.body_html:
Sabotage Studio has made a reputation of blending retro aesthetics with modern game design methods to create new, wholly original experiences like The Messenger — something we here at iam8bit absolutely adore. And their latest game is their most ambitious masterwork yet. 


So you can see why we’re practically bursting with excitement about this announcement. iam8bit and Sabotage have teamed up to bring you Sea of Stars on glorious physical media — exactly the way that a loving tribute to ‘90s-era RPGs should be experienced. 


Sea of Stars pays homage to the great RPGs of the genre’s golden age, but with distinctly Sabotage-style twists that modernize the experience in electrifying ways; seamless platformer-style traversal through a gorgeous overworld, engaging and innovative tweaks to classic turn-based combat, dozens of original characters aboard in a captivating, epic tale, and breathtaking, crisp 2D pixel-art that pushes the boundaries of what’s possible on a screen. 


Get ready for the turn-based RPG you never even dreamed was possible, presented with all the love & care that only an iam8bit Exclusive Edition can provide and busting at the brim with physical goodness like a retro-style game manual, a double-sided poster featuring original artwork and an oversized world map, character sprite stickers and a (not so physical, but still fantastic) digital download code of the entire games soundtrack, featuring music by Eric W. Brown, Yasunori Mitsuda, Vincent Jackson Jones II and Reece Miller.

PLEASE NOTE: While our Exclusive Edition offers worldwide compatibility, there may be some compatibility difficulties with DLC in other regions. If you’re interested in any future DLCs for Sea of Stars, we recommend looking for a retail copy compatible with your region via our website here.

Developer Something We Made’s pictorial adventure, TOEM, is an expedition across a world populated by folks with all sorts of quirky problems ripe for the solvin’ — between snapshots, of course. It’s a charming romp through a hand-drawn landscape, meditative in its coziness and comfort. And now, you can own it on physical media.

In true iam8bit Physical Edition fashion, we’ve crafted a package so thematic, you’ll want to snap a few pics of it for your favorite photo album. Sure, it’s the complete game, on disc/cartridge, but open it up and you’ll find a special surprise inside — an assortment of character standees depicting some of your favorite friends from the world of TOEM! Take ‘em out in the wild and keep your photo tour going in the real world. And while you’re at it, tag us on instagram (@iam8bit) with some of your favorite shots, and we might just share ‘em! 

Rounding out the delightful package is absolutely charming monochromatic box art from acclaimed artist Nuri Durr. 

Photos might fade, but adventures like TOEM last a lifetime. Don’t miss the opportunity to bring this one home.

products.title: Bomb Rush Cyberfunk (PlayStation Exclusive Edition)
products.body_html:
Bomb Rush Cyberfunk is Team Reptile’s tribute to late ‘90s/early 2000s skater culture – a time of sick grinds, sick rides, and sick beats. It’s a stylish vision of a future populated by dueling graffiti gangs, duking it out to become the best crew in the city (and dodging the five-o fuzz along the way). 

It’s a hot, hot wave of nostalgia for a bygone era, remixed into something totally new – and if there’s one thing our iam8bit crew loves, it’s a good remix. 

That’s why we’re so proud to present the Bomb Rush Cyberfunk Exclusive Edition: A loving tribute to Team Reptile’s graffiti-filled throwback, presented on funky-fresh physical media. 

In addition to the game on disc/cartridge, you’ll also get a certifiably sick graffiti booklet highlighting some of the amazing original art present in the game. Artist Tan Zhi Hui captured the game’s 1 second per second of advanced funkstyle spirit with an incredible cover illustration. 

Get ready to go All City with the Bomb Rush Cyberfunk Exclusive Edition. Oh yeah!

products.title: Neon White (PlayStation 5 Exclusive Edition)
products.body_html:
What’s waiting for you behind the Pearly Gates?

No one can be sure, but Neon White provides an inspired hypothesis that seeks to answer that question. It’s the story of the titular assassin, hand-picked from Hell and chosen to compete with other demon slayers for a shot at posthumous redemption and a permanent stay at some more agreeable afterlife digs. 


Developed by our pals at Angel Matrix and published by Annapurna Interactive, Neon White is a fast-paced galvanic supercharger of a game. Its look, sound, and feel are sure to warm the hearts of any once-and-future mall goths, with an aesthetic that practically oozes bootleg ‘90s VHS anime tapes. Its gameplay, meanwhile, takes influence from epic community-driven speedruns to deliver an innovative card-based time trial experience. 


It’s the kind of mash-up brilliance we at iam8bit love to see in indie games. We’re elated, then, to bring you this Neon White Exclusive Edition, a physical version of the game that would make any true sicko proud.


In addition to the game, presented region-free with worldwide compatibility on glorious physical media, you’ll get an exclusive cover sheet from Neon White artist Rebecca Ryan. And since we know you can’t get enough of those lovable neon freaks, we’ve also included 5 Neon White peeker stickers, each one featuring a different charming assassin. 


Whether you’re resting comfortably in Heaven or waiting out your afterlife sentence down in Hell, one thing’s for sure: The Neon White Exclusive Edition is sure to make a prideful addition to your gaming shelf. 

 

 

 

© 2022 Angel Matrix LLC. Developed by Ben Esposito. Published by Annapurna Interactive under exclusive license. All rights reserved.

products.title: Bear and Breakfast (Nintendo Switch Exclusive Edition)
products.body_html:
Hank, the star of Bear and Breakfast, is many things: A plucky teenager. A good friend. A savvy entrepreneur in the hospitality industry. And, of course, a seven-foot-tall 400 pound forest bear.


In this quirky indie management sim from the folks at Armor Games Studios and Gummy Cat Studios, Hank and his friends find an abandoned shack and flip it into a money-making bed and breakfast scheme for unsuspecting tourists. But as they start to taste success, the crew find themselves plunged into a plot much deeper than the wilderness itself. 


It’s the sort of creative & charming laid-back adventure that iam8bit simply adores, so we’re happy to bear (c’mon, we get to do that once) the honor of bringing you the Bear and Breakfast Exclusive Edition for Nintendo Switch. It’s the complete game on-cartridge, ready-to-play and region free, packaged in exclusive cover art from sculptor and first-time iam8bit collaborator cobcris. 


That’s not all: Packed inside, you’ll find a code for a digital download of the Bear and Breakfast original soundtrack by Andrew Landry! It’s an inspired collection of synthy sounds that range from playful & light to mysterious & dark, perfectly complementing the game’s unexpected woodland conspiracies. 


As an added bonus, we’ve also included an adorable motel-style Hank keychain. Put it on your key the next time you stay in a snuggly bed & breakfast and smile fondly at the thought of your virtual woodland friends, or just hang it on a handbag, backpack, or anywhere else you might need a pal.

products.title: Cuphead (Xbox One - Limited Edition)
products.body_html:
In the half-decade since its debut, Studio MDHR’s Cuphead has cemented itself as one of the juggernauts of the indie scene – a beloved boss-fight-extravaganza with an art style & aesthetic the likes of which had never before been seen in games.


A global phenomenon demands a phenomenal physical edition. This is the Cuphead: Limited Edition, a spectacular tribute to the stellar run-’n’-gun game born out of the friendship between iam8bit and Studio MDHR. 

Inside, you’ll find the complete Cuphead experience on disc/cart, including the sensation that started it all as well as the flabbergastingly good follow-up DLC, The Delicious Last Course.

Also in said case: Six (6) illustrated “Cuphead Funnies,” single-panel comics straight from the minds of Studio MDHR themselves. They feature Cuphead and his pal Mugman getting into all sorts of their signature mischief. 

If that weren’t enough, you’ll also find an individually-numbered Cuphead Club Membership card, officially bestowing on you all the honors and responsibilities that come with being one of the world’s foremost run-and-gunners. 

The fun doesn’t stop there. We’ve also included a brand-new goodie for this edition. Harkening back to the days of wooden toys and mechanical curiosities…it’s the Miss Chalice Push Toy! Marvel as she falls and gets back up, again and again…not unlike so many tenacious players working their way through one of Cuphead’s signature challenging boss bouts, to boot!

Yes indeed, friend…This edition of Cuphead is a treasure trove of endless entertainment, specially designed for only the most discerning connoisseurs of the finest action indie gaming has to offer. 

Don’t forget - there’s also the super deluxe Collector’s Edition of Cuphead, featuring a beautifully handmade Cuphead marionette, available RIGHT HERE. 

Shipping to Japan is not available for this product.

products.title: Cozy Grove (Nintendo Switch Exclusive Edition)
products.body_html:
Cozy Grove isn’t just a peaceful game. It’s a game about building peace.

Each day, you wander the haunted forest, uncovering secrets and doing favors for your spectral neighbors to help soothe them and bring color back to the island’s gorgeous, hand-drawn locales. It’s a different take on the popular life-sim genre; one that asks not only for endless engagement, but also for quick and tidy half-hour play sessions that leave you feeling refreshed and accomplished.

At iam8bit, we know the reward of a good day’s work, so we sprung at the chance to work with developer Spry Fox and publisher The Quantum Astrophysicists Guild to give Cozy Grove the Exclusive Edition treatment. It includes a gorgeous cover sheet from Spry Fox’s own Noemí Gómez. And inside, of course, you’ll find the game, complete on disc/cartridge, ready to play, and region-free.

As an extra special perk for all you bear collectors out there: You’ll also nab an exclusive ‘blind bag’ pin, inspired by the titular island’s ghostly denizens. Wear ‘em out to the store and show the world you’re a Spirit Scout with style. There are 28 collectible pins in total, with 1 randomly included in each package — we encourage trading!

products.title: Akupara Games Triple Birthday Bundle
products.body_html:
iam8bit and Akupara Games are like peanut butter and jelly. Since the publisher’s founding on the back of a giant tortoise, we’ve admired their eye for meaningful, quality games and their heartfelt devotion to bringing those games to a wider audience. 

This bundle is a celebration of that Akupara approach to publishing, a collection of three titles that represent the wide, weird and exciting scope of what indie games can be. 

From Die Gute Fabrik’s ethereal gardening adventure game Mutazione, to artist Jesse Jacob’s bubbly & psychedelic Spinch, to the gravity-defying puzzles of Altered Matter’s Etherborn, Akupara Games have curated a catalog of games worthy of your shelf space. We’re happy to play our part in bringing them to your door with this stunning collection. 

It’s all in celebration of Akupara Games’ 6th birthday — and what’s a birthday bash without a little party favor? That’s why we’re including a button with every order. So when your friends ask why you’ve got a turtle in a birthday hat on your jacket, you can puff out your chest, look them in the eye, and speak the truth with pride: It’s because you love indie games.

products.title: Garbage Pail Kids: Mad Mike and the Quest for Stale Gum (NES Cartridge)
products.body_html:
In the 80s, the world was ruled by two things: the Nintendo Entertainment System and Garbage Pail Kids cards. These lovable, grossout monster children could be found in the lunchboxes of every latchkey kid, juvenile delinquent, rascal, and brat in your neighborhood. At the same time, Nintendo was taking over America with their first home video game console. So, it only made perfect sense when these two dominant forces of 80s pop culture came together… right? Right?????

Well, here’s the thing: that never happened. UNTIL NOW!!

iam8bit Presents, alongside the developers/time-travelers at Retrotainment and our friends at Topps, are proud to reveal this Long-Lost, All-New Garbage Pail Kids NES Game on a real, functioning NES Cartridge! That’s right, Garbage Pail Kids: Mad Mike and the Quest for Stale Gum is a BRAND NEW NES game! This old school platformer features four playable GPK characters, six disgusting, secret-filled levels, and its own trading-card system. It’s a complete throwback to the golden era of gaming.

And of course, we had to house it all in a SICK iam8bit-exclusive NES Cartridge collector’s package. Available in both Stale Gum Pink and Mad Mike Blue color variants, this box also includes a Full-Color, Premium Instruction Booklet and an Exclusive batch of Pixel Art GPK Cards. Pop this sucker in your NES! Cuz it’ll actually work!!

products.title: Stray (PlayStation) - iam8bit Exclusive Edition
products.body_html:
When developer BlueTwelve Studios dubbed their cyberpunk adventure game, Stray, they were gesturing towards something deeper than feline wordplay. To “stray” is to get lost, to wander from the path, to find oneself suddenly far away from home. 


Seeing the game’s long-forgotten, futuristic metropolis through the low perspective of a roaming cat certainly evokes that central thesis. Despite its relative hostility, the city’s seedy underbelly becomes a playground for all manner of nimble, stealthy antics as Stray’s protagonist (joined by the stalwart drone, B-12) works to find a way to get back home. 


In collaboration with BlueTwelve Studios and Annapurna Interactive, we are proud to present this iam8bit Exclusive Edition of Stray for PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4. It includes a 14.4” x 24” poster of the iconic first teaser image released for Stray, harkening back to the initial reveal that so excited a heavily overlapping Venn diagram of gamers & cat fans. This edition also includes six (6) art cards, plus a fuzzy, pettable chenille patch of our feline hero, perfect for adorning backpacks of any size. It’s all packaged within a matte black o-sleeve featuring a premium holofoil finish.

products.title: Psychonauts 2 Collector's Edition
products.body_html:
.

With its sharp writing, quick wit, lovable cast, and figment-chasing gameplay, 2005’s Psychonauts garnered a well-deserved following that only became more ravenous for even more Raz-powered adventures. Developer Double Fine released Psychonauts 2 in 2021 and more than lived up to the first game’s legacy, earning a fair share of “Game of the Year” nods along the way. 


Now, we’re honoring these two games with a supreme Collector’s Edition worthy of its own merit badge. The PlayStation 4 version comes with both Psychonauts & Psychonauts 2, each on their own disc. For the Xbox One version, you’ll get Psychonauts & Psychonauts 2 on one disc and two discs, respectively. This marks not only the first time Psychonauts has been printed on disc for Xbox One, but it also marks the first time a backwards compatible Xbox game has had a disc release for Xbox One… EVVVVERRRRR!!


You’ll also get everything that’s included with our Psychonauts 2 “Motherlobe Edition,” including a lenticular o-sleeve, a premium die-cut sticker pack, six art cards, and a digital download of exclusive behind-the-scenes development concepts. 


This “Collector’s Edition” also includes a bevy of exclusive goods, including a reversible cover sheet you won’t find anywhere else, a 5-pin set of the psychedelic brain rock band, Feast of the Senses, an 18x24” blacklight poster of everyone’s favorite circus runaway Raz, and a bonus sticker sheet. Plus, we’ve included a download of all three volumes of the Psychonauts 2 Original Soundtrack! It’s all packaged in a neat and exclusive collector’s box, perfect for storing any and all emotional baggage. 


Both the cover sheet & box sport mind-bending artwork from illustrator Arno Kiss. It all adds up to a Collector’s Edition worth its weight in honey pepper boar bacon.

products.body_html:

DUSTBITERS is quick to learn and easy to understand. There are very few rules, but an infinite number of creative ways to get yourself out of a tough situation. Cars are *everything*. products.body_html:
Game Developers Choice Awards - Best Debut Finalist 2019

The conundrum of video games is that there is always a limitation — whether budget, memory and/or time. There’s no escaping this practicality… or is there? Case study anomaly: the technological and artistic achievement that is Manifold Garden, created by the genius William Chyr over the course of 8½ painstaking years. At first blush, it’s a psychics-dripping puzzle game, but examine further and you’ll realize that it has actually cracked the conundrum. It is “infinity incarnate” — an endless masterwork that tells a finite story, but does so with the beautiful illusion of absolutely limitless scope. Environments stretch of forever and ever, but yet, despite its impossible architectural trappings, there is a natural beauty at play. You, the player, are meant to cultivate a garden, and by encouraging the prosperity of plantlife and waterways, you continue to unlock the many secrets of this abstract and amazing world.

products.title: Spiritfarer Collector's Edition
products.body_html:
Spiritfarer is a once-in-a-lifetime experience that dares to explore themes and relationships rarely contemplated in video games. Acclaimed developer Thunder Lotus masterfully plops the player into the shoes (and floppy hat) of Stella, a plucky, newly ordained ferrymaster for the deceased. In short, you’re a “spiritfarer” — but it’s much less an occupation and much more, a journey. On the surface, it’s a cozy management game, where familiar mechanics like farming and crafting certainly play a role — and customizing your ship adds a dash of fun. But digging a little deeper, at its core, Spiritfarer is a magical and emotional opus, chock full of wonderful characters with whom deep bonds are formed. Sadly (but also, quite profoundly), these relationships are fleeting, as the inevitability remains: the passengers are dying, and you’re escorting them to the afterlife. We can say, with absolute certainty, that you will cry while playing Spiritfarer — probably multiple times — because saying goodbye to pals is always hard. Yet, as vast as the world is, traversing hundreds of miles of ocean and islands, the real marvel here is the internalized heart. We guarantee that every memory of your time spent with this well-dressed, gregarious and incredibly charming cast of creatures will be indelibly imprinted upon your soul. 


Exploring the Collector’s Edition:


We couldn’t recommend Spiritfarer more enthusiastically, and as such, we’ve crafted a collector’s edition befitting of its carefully crafted nuances. In true iam8bit fashion, we’ve created an ultra custom and premium Collector’s Edition experience, starting with the packaging itself. It’s a lovely box in which to house all of the cool contents, sure, but also — it doubles as a stunning and functional display piece. Simply turn on the included 1:1 replica Everlight and — viola — the lantern illuminates, inspiring the diecut constellations to magically glow. It’s 360-degree design makes it oh so appropriate as a tabletop centerpiece - or perhaps floating overhead, dangling from a ceiling hook.


Additionally, we’ve included several incredible items that speak to the emotional cadence of the game. One of our favorites is a Postcard and Stamp set, lovingly detailed with fan favorite locations from the game. While most of the postcards are meant to be displayed, one rather unique card is meant to be personalized by you and actually mailed off — but we’ll let you discover why. 


Rounding out the deluxe package are a set of recipe cards; digital soundtrack and 96-page digital art book; and, no doubt — a physical version of Spiritfarer, featuring exclusive, reversible cover art by renowned artist Aidan Yetman-Michaelson. We highly recommend this Collector’s Edition of Spiritfarer if you’re looking to discover and/or deepen your relationship with one of the most stunningly gorgeous and intimately poignant games ever made.

Untitled Goose Game is nothing short of a *honk*nomenon (sorry!), having transcended the hallowed halls of nerdom to become an essential piece of the cultural zeitgeist. Australian developer House House created the ultimate anti-hero with their headlining Goose, crafting a clever and genre-busting puzzler that achieves brilliance with hilarious gestures and impeccable nuance. Everything about this game is charming, from its deftly styled animation to its subtle yet dynamic soundtrack. Included here is a very special mail order-style ‘Catalog of Junk,’ a perfectly informative illustrated booklet, and an elegantly hand-illustrated town map, both made exclusively for the physical edition of the game. It’s enough to make you wanna *honk* *honk*


Adding to that, iam8bit is proud to debut a secret initiative we’ve been working on for the past year: “Eco-Packaging” for physical games. We’re no strangers to engineering unique and crazy packaging, and we’ve spared no expense to prototype dozens of variations of our eco-friendly alternative to plastic game cases… which has led us to this moment. Untitled Goose Game is the perfect title to team up with for the debut of PS4 packaging that we hope leads an entire industry into the future. Consider this our “Early Access Alpha” version of eco-packaging:

  • 100% Post-Consumer Waste Material Case
  • 100% Recyclable
  • Non-Toxic, 0% VOC inks 
  • Booklet and Foldout Poster are all 100% Recyclable Paper Stocks from sustainable sources
  • “No Goose” Sticker - Tree-Free, Made from Sugar Cane Waste; Recycle-Compatible Adhesive
  • Eco-Friendly Shrink Wrap (it’s called “Biolefin”!)

products.title: WHAT THE GOLF? (Nintendo Switch Physical Edition)
products.body_html:
WHAT THE GOLF? isn’t just a question — it’s also a game that exploits, to excellent comic hijinx, the scientific principles of physics. In addition, it oh so poetically queries — why do we only golf using golf balls? Why not cars? Office chairs? Even horses or giraffes? This is one of those rare, brilliant and absolutely hilarious gameplay experiences that doesn’t just entertain, it reminds us that innovation comes in all forms, including via a surplus of whimsy. We dare you not to smile while trying to 9-iron a mobile home for a hole-in-one.

products.title: Creature in the Well (PlayStation 4 Physical Edition)
products.body_html:
“Creature in the Well plays like no other hack and slash I’ve ever encountered...It’s a clever way to breathe new life into a genre that can sometimes feel pretty tired.” —Polygon

The end goal is a familiar one, but the story and mechanics are brand new. In Flight School’s thrilling Creature in the Well, classic pinball mechanics are reimagined as a sci-fi, top-down adventure epic… and it’s a genre mashup that works brilliantly well. You play as the last robot engineer on Earth, hustling to save the planet from a nasty dust storm. The only thing standing in your way in this pinball hack-n-slash? You guessed it — that damn creature. Complete with a set of 5 double-sided art cards (randomized from a total of 15 designs!) and a 72-page downloadable art book, it’s safe to say this edition is well worth it.

The majesty of The Lion King is cinematic legend, and when it comes to video games, its SNES adaptation truly pushed the limits of what was possible in the 16-bit era. From its nuanced character animation to its epic (and gut-wrenching) Wildebeest stampede, the Serengetti-spanning scope of the film was impressively captured on cartridge in all its glory. This ultimate Legacy Cartridge Collection edition pays tribute to the impossible feats that The Lion King achieved way back in 1994, with painstakingly restoration of all the original artwork and presentation in a premium package fit for royalty, complete with all the retro trappings, including an all-important, custom dust cover.

products.title: Hyper Light Drifter Collector’s Edition - Legacy Cartridge Collection
products.body_html:
"Hyper Light Drifter deftly mixes contemplative moments with breakneck action" - Polygon

"I adored every second I spent in Hyper Light Drifter's world" - Destructoid

"Hyper Light Drifter is great. Really great" - Kotaku

 

With nostalgic hearts on full display, Heart Machine and iam8bit have joined (retro) forces to create the Hyper Light Drifter: Collector’s Edition!

Like all of iam8bit's products, this is a lovingly crafted package, designed to evoke a sense of retro-gaming nostalgia via this masterfully produced SNES bundle. We’ve partnered with Rose Colored Gaming and Piko Interactive to bring you this true labor of love that will fit perfectly next to all of your other SNES games.

No detail was spared! The SNES-style box, 24-page instruction manual and even the metallic sticker on the cartridge were designed by Hyper Light Drifter Heart Machine to perfectly capture the special essence of 16-bit magic. The cartridge is is custom modeled with colored plastic, replicating the now-defunct production process used back in the day.

While looking completely authentic, this cartridge won’t play anything when plugged into your Super Nintendo… but that’s why we’re giving you a game code with purchase!



     Echoes of a dark and violent past resonate throughout a savage land, steeped in treasure and blood. Hyper Light Drifter is an action adventure RPG in the vein of the best 16­bit classics, with modernized mechanics and designs on a much grander scale.Drifters of this world are the collectors of forgotten knowledge, lost technologies and broken histories. Our Drifter is haunted by an insatiable illness, traveling further into the lands of Buried Time, hoping to discover a way to quiet the vicious disease.
    • From each character to subtle background elements, everything is lovingly hand-animated.

    • Easy to pick up, difficult to master; enemies are vicious and numerous, hazards will easily crush your frail body, and friendly faces remain rare.
    • Upgrade weapons, learn new skills, discover equipment and traverse a dark, detailed world with branching paths and secrets abound.
